description.ru: Развивайте деловой английский уровня B1 по теме «Деловые предложения, процессы и улучшения».
description.en: Develop B1 business English for business proposals, processes and improvements.

objective.ru: Использовать деловой английский уровня B1 для ясного обмена информацией, объяснения причин и согласования действий.
objective.en: Use B1 business English to exchange information clearly, explain reasons, and agree actions.

instructions.en: Match the English words with their translations.

data.question: Which response communicates the business point most effectively?

options.text: The proposal explains how the revised process could improve efficiency without reducing service quality.
The details are unimportant and no action needs to be agreed.
The message should avoid explaining its purpose.

data.explanation: The correct answer communicates a clear business point and connects information with its purpose or consequence.
